name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Account Manager | Upsell, Cross-Sell, Renewals & Net Retention
summary: SaaS account manager who grows revenue inside an existing book. Retained all but one of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye (~94%), held 120% of sales targets while onboarding 25+ clients a month at Wix, and ranked top three of 8 to 15 reps at Accelo while quota roughly doubled. Lands the account, drives adoption, then expands it through scoped upsells and new services tied to each client's goals. Runs pipeline in Salesforce and HubSpot with forecast-level accuracy, and has spent years training teams and running client workshops, the same work Absorb's customers buy a learning platform to do.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Expand retainer scope inside an existing client base, identifying complementary services and writing the proposals and statements of work to close them.
Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running discovery to surface goals, buying priorities, and growth constraints.
Drive adoption of complex SaaS platforms after the sale, leading onboarding, technical setup, and hands-on training rather than handing off.
Report results to business owners on a regular cadence with dashboards tracking pipeline, funnel progression, and ROI.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 multi-stakeholder client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, peaking above $100K/month, as strategic lead across internal departments.
Delivered quarterly business reviews with ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion reporting, turning performance data into budget and growth recommendations.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a book of 15-20 reseller partners with deal sizes of ~$10K-$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and intervene before they turned into churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and product value, deepening engagement across health, home services, and retail verticals.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that reduced onboarding friction across a high-volume partner network (50+ daily activities).
Routed structured customer feedback to Product and Engineering, linking field signals to roadmap decisions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each, several exceeding $25K, for roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, and led the sales team.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding and launching 25+ clients per month.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training sessions, 1:1 coaching, and workshops for new initiatives.
Drove team initiatives for a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including sales training for tenured account executives.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank while quota roughly doubled.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, consistently into accelerator tiers.
Wrote proposals and statements of work for agencies and professional-services firms across a global client base, building sequenced implementation plans for the implementation team to execute.
Ran workshops for client teams showing how each part of the product fit their workflow, building C-suite relationships as a trusted advisor.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle SaaS sales to SMBs, making up to 150 dials/day and closing up to 10 deals/month.
